newsitem.title: POLAND: BPH to decide details of bond issue Feb.
newsitem.headline: BPH to decide details of bond issue Feb.

text.p: Poland's Bank Przemyslowo- Handlowy SA (BPH) is due to decide next month whether its planned $100 million convertible bond issue will be a public offering or a private placement, the bank's president said.
"We haven't taken the decision yet...it has to be decided by the second half of February," Henryka Pieronkiewicz told reporters on Monday.
She said the bonds were likely to be issued in the first half of April.
The bank will issue up to 100,000 fixed bonds with a par value of $1000 each and maturity of up to five years and the issue would be exchangeable for up to 1,994,000 shares.
The funds from the issue are planned to finance the bank's credit expansion, especially the growth of foreign currency credits.
